name: Return the Book
summary: Bethor Iceshard sends his enchanted message back to Gunther Arcanus on Brightwater Lake. The stolen spellbook may bring his old Kirin Tor companion into the Forsaken fold.

sections.title: A Message in Arcane Ink
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard sends an arcane message to Gunther Arcanus through a stolen spellbook. Once Bethor learns the necromancer on Brightwater Lake is his old companion, he enchants the tome's pages. The spell leaves Bethor's own magical mark, showing he is active in Lordaeron and free of the Lich King's control.

sections.title: The Old Circle of Dalaran
sections.body: Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor Iceshard, Gunther Arcanus, and Thule Ravenclaw studied and became friends in the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. When the Lich King rose, Thule betrayed his companions and joined the Scourge willingly. Bethor and Gunther fell to the Plague. Bethor later broke free alongside Queen Sylvanas. Believing Gunther dead or enslaved, Bethor now learns his old friend has also won his own freedom and seeks to bring him to the Forsaken.

sections.title: Mistrust on the Island
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus meets an intruder on his island with fury. He suspects a Scourge agent has come to enslave him again, or that the thief who stole his magic has returned. Then he sees his grimoire and feels Bethor's familiar magic in it. The sign of someone from his mortal past forces the solitary mage to question his isolation.

faq.q: Why did Bethor enchant Gunther's spellbook?
aliases: what did bethor do to the book
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard enchants the stolen spellbook with his magical signature to show Gunther he is free of the Lich King. A plain messenger might be rejected or destroyed by Gunther, who fears the Scourge.

faq.q: Who was Gunther Arcanus before he died?
faq.answer: Before his death, Gunther Arcanus was a human mage and Kirin Tor scholar in Dalaran. He studied with Bethor Iceshard and Thule Ravenclaw before the Third War, then fell to the Scourge's Plague of Undeath.

faq.q: Why is Gunther hiding on Brightwater Lake?
aliases: why is gunther on the island
faq.answer: After breaking free of the Lich King's control, Gunther believed he was alone in his freedom. He hid on an island in Brightwater Lake to escape the Scourge and living enemies who might hunt or kill him.
Thule Ravenclaw was a fellow Kirin Tor student of Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus in Dalaran. Unlike them, Thule willingly serves the Scourge as a loyal necromancer in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Gunther think the player is a thief?
aliases: why does gunther call me a thief
faq.answer: Bethor earlier sent Forsaken adventurers into Gunther's sanctum to steal his spellbook and learn who was practicing necromancy on the lake. Gunther recognizes the returning adventurer as the one who robbed him.

faq.q: Does Gunther immediately join the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. Gunther is stunned to learn Bethor lives and is free, but remains wary of the Forsaken. He asks you to prove you oppose the Scourge by summoning and destroying its agent Lillith Nefara at an old altar off the island's southern coast.

angles.text: As an undead, you share Gunther's struggle: waking from mindless service to face a hostile, lonely world.
As a mage, you know how former Kirin Tor magi can recognize one another's magic across undeath.
As a member of the Horde, you help strengthen Undercity's arcane ranks when independent undead sorcerers like Gunther join the cause against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
